# AstanaVis card art upload folder

Place character card art in this folder using these exact filenames. Transparent PNG works best.

| Character | Ordinary art | Legendary art |
|---|---|---|
| Mia | `mia-ordinary.png` | `mia-legendary.png` |
| Akira | `akira-ordinary.png` | `akira-legendary.png` |
| Yuna | `yuna-ordinary.png` | `yuna-legendary.png` |
| Julie | `julie-ordinary.png` | `julie-legendary.png` |
| Sakura | `sakura-ordinary.png` | `sakura-legendary.png` |
| Rin | `rin-ordinary.png` | `rin-legendary.png` |
| Hana | `hana-ordinary.png` | `hana-legendary.png` |
| Naomi | `naomi-ordinary.png` | `naomi-legendary.png` |
| Emi | `emi-ordinary.png` | `emi-legendary.png` |
| Kira | `kira-ordinary.png` | `kira-legendary.png` |

File names are lowercase. After copying images here, tell me and I will generate/upload a new DEV build. A local file copy alone does not update the hosted preview.

Internal item IDs remain `neko-01-t1` through `neko-10-t2`; each character has an isolated server Craft recipe (5 T1 → 1 T2).
